# Phase 8A, Pass 5R -- deterministic dependency resolution for Python 3.13.
#
# Generated by: `python -m pip freeze` inside a sterile, isolated worktree +
# virtual environment (secrets stripped from the subprocess environment,
# no .env/TeamDump/cache/NCAA-Player-Radars present) after installing
# requirements.txt + requirements-dev.txt with streamlit==1.57.0 and
# pandas==2.3.3 explicitly pinned. This exact combination was proven, not
# assumed, to pass: 0 failures across the full non-live suite (4,603 passed,
# 456 expected local-data skips), tests/api (267/267), API+rate-limiter
# (309/309), 6/6 migrations to head 5b02bea0eb85, and both manifest files
# (1,157/1,156 rows, identical keys, zero duplicates). Full evidence and the
# dependency-isolation matrix that proved causality: docs/phase8_dependency_stabilization.md.
#
# PLATFORM SCOPE -- WINDOWS ONLY. This resolution was generated on Windows 10
# (build 19045) and includes Windows-only packages (pywin32, pywinpty,
# colorama) that do not exist for Linux/macOS. This is NOT a cross-platform
# lock file. A Linux/macOS clean install using this constraints file as-is
# will fail to resolve pywin32/pywinpty -- a future cross-platform release
# would need either a platform-conditional constraints file (using
# environment markers) or separate per-platform files. No such claim is made
# or implied here; this file documents exactly the one platform this project
# has ever been validated on.
#
# Use:
#   python -m pip install -c constraints-release-py313.txt -r requirements.txt
#   python -m pip install -c constraints-release-py313.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
#
# This file constrains versions already requested by requirements.txt /
# requirements-dev.txt (via pip's -c flag) -- it does not itself request
# any package to be installed. Do not `pip install -r` this file directly.
